selector.title: Khetha izwe nolimi lwakho
selector.intro: I-Budify iguqulela ulwazi lwayo lomthetho, izilungiselelo zobumfihlo nokuqukethwe ezweni lakho. Sikhetha kusengaphambili izwe ngokususelwa ekuxhumekeni kwakho, kodwa ungakhetha elinye noma inini.

selector.remember: Sikhumbula ukukhetha kwakho ku-cookie edingekile ngokuphelele kulo msebenzi.

ageGate.title: Abaphathi bamabhizinisi kuphela
ageGate.body: Le webhusayithi ingeyabaphathi bamabhizinisi nochwepheshe emkhakheni wensangu elawulwayo. Ayinabo imikhiqizo, amanani noma iziphakamiso zabathengi.
ageGate.checkbox: Ngineminyaka engu-{age}+ futhi ngiyisiphathi sebhizinisi noma uchwepheshe.
ageGate.leftBody: Le webhusayithi iyabantu abaphethe amabhizinisi abaneminyaka engu-{age}+ kuphela. Awungenanga kusayithi.
ageGate.cookieNote: Ukukhetha othi “Ngena kusayithi” kugcina impendulo yakho ku-cookie yohlangothi lokuqala edingekile ngokuphelele kulo msebenzi (izinsuku ezingu-30).

cookie.title: Ama-cookie nobuchwepheshe obufanayo
cookie.body: Sisebenzisa ama-cookie adingekile ngokuphelele ukuze lesi sayithi sisebenze. Ngemvume yakho, sifuna nokusebenzisa ama-cookie e-analytics ukuze siqonde ukuthi isayithi lisetshenziswa kanjani. Asisebenzisi ama-cookie ezikhangiso ngaphandle kokuthi uwamukele.
cookie.bodyOptOut: Sisebenzisa ama-cookie adingekile ngokuphelele ukuze lesi sayithi sisebenze futhi, ngaphandle kokuthi ukhethe ukungabi yingxenye, i-analytics ukusithuthukisa. Siyalihlonipha uphawu lwe-Global Privacy Control.
cookie.bodyNotice: Sisebenzisa ama-cookie ukuze lesi sayithi sisebenze nokuqonda ukuthi sisetshenziswa kanjani. Ungashintsha ukukhetha kwakho noma inini.

necessary.title: Adingekile
necessary.desc: Adingekile ekuphepheni, ekukhetheni kwakho izwe nolimi, ekuqinisekisweni komphathi nasekukhumbuleni lokhu kukhetha kwama-cookie. Ahlala evuliwe.

analytics.title: I-analytics
analytics.desc: Isisiza siqonde ukuthi yiwaphi amakhasi anosizo. Ivaliwe uze uyamukele.

marketing.title: Ukumaketha
marketing.desc: Asetshenziselwa ukukala nokwenza ngokwezifiso izikhangiso zethu. Asisebenzisi nhlobo ama-cookie okumaketha okwamanje.

cookie.gpc: Isiphequluli sakho sithumele uphawu lwe-Global Privacy Control, ngakho i-analytics nokumaketha kuvaliwe.
cookie.withdraw: Ungashintsha noma ubuyise imvume yakho noma inini usebenzisa u-“Izilungiselelo zama-cookie” ngezansi ekhasini.

pos.body: Ukukhokha okusheshayo ngokuskena ibhakhodi, ukuhlola ilungu ngaphambi kwesithengiselwano ngasinye nokubala imali ekupheleni kosuku.

membership.body: Amaphrofayili amalungu, amakhadi obulungu edijithali, ukulandelela isimo nokuphelelwa isikhathi, nezimvume ezicacile.

compliance.title: Imibiko yokuhambisana nemithetho
compliance.body: Ama-audit trail namarekhodi angathekelelwa asiza ukulungisa imibiko ememezelwe umlawuli wakho.

inventory.title: Ukulawula isitoko
inventory.body: Isitoko ngezinga lebhetshi, amarekhodi abahlinzeki, ukubalwa kwesitoko nemibiko yokwehluka ezindaweni eziningi.

multistore.title: Ukulawula izindawo eziningi
multistore.body: Phatha izindawo eziningi, izindima zabasebenzi nemibiko emaphakathi ku-akhawunti eyodwa.

home.audienceIntro: Khetha isixazululo esihambisana nendlela osebenza ngayo.
home.complianceBody: Imithetho yensangu iyahluka ezweni ngalinye. Isikhungo Sethu Sokuhambisana Nemithetho sichaza, ngemakethe ngayinye, ukuthi i-Budify isekela kanjani ukugcinwa kwamarekhodi nokubika – nokuthi umthwalo usala kuphi kuwe.
home.ctaBody: Bhuka i-demo emfushane neqembu lethu. Sizoyilungiselela imakethe yakho nendlela osebenza ngayo.

features.title: Izici ezifanele imisebenzi elawulwayo
features.intro: Imojuli ngayinye yabelana ngesizindalwazi esisodwa, i-audit trail eyodwa nemodeli eyodwa yezimvume.

pos.title: I-point of sale
pos.body: Ukukhokha okusheshayo ngokuskena ibhakhodi ne-QR, ukuqinisekisa ilungu ngaphambi kwesithengiselwano ngasinye, amathemineli amaningi nama-risidi anyathelisiwe noma edijithali.

assoc.title: Amarekhodi okwabiwa
assoc.body: Rekhoda ukwabiwa ngakunye kulungu, hlola isimo sobulungu nemikhawulo yokwabiwa ngaphambi kwesithengiselwano ngasinye, ugcine ilogi ebonisa ukuchezuka.

membership.title: Ukuphatha ubulungu
membership.body: Amaphrofayili amalungu anokuqinisekiswa kobuwena, amakhadi obulungu edijithali anamakhodi e-QR, ukulandelela ukuphelelwa isikhathi nokukhansela ngokushesha.

inventory.title: Isitoko nokulawula isitoko
inventory.body: Isitoko sesikhathi sangempela ngendawo ngayinye esinokulandelela ibhetshi, amarekhodi abahlinzeki, ukubuyiswa nokubalwa kwesitoko ngokungabonwa okuqhathaniswa namanani esistimu.

compliance.title: Ama-audit trail nemibiko
compliance.body: Ukuhamba ngakunye kwesitoko, ukuthengisa nokushintsha ubulungu kurekhodwa ngokuthi ngubani, yini nini. Thekelela imininingwane oyidingayo emibikweni yakho.

finance.title: Amarekhodi ezezimali
finance.body: Ukulandelela ukuthengisa nezindleko, ukubala imali yansuku zonke, izindleko zokuthengisa nenzuzo eyinkulumbuso ngendawo ngayinye.

assoc.title: Izimali zobulungu nama-akhawunti amalungu
assoc.body: Landelela izimali zobulungu, amabhalansi ama-akhawunti amalungu nezindleko zenhlangano ngemibiko ecacile yomgcini wezimali nemihlangano yamalungu.

analytics.title: Ukuqonda umsebenzi
analytics.body: Qonda ukuvakashelwa, izikhathi ezixakile nokuhamba kwesitoko ngamadeshibhodi akhelwe imininingwane yakho.

multistore.title: Ukuphatha izindawo eziningi
multistore.body: Phatha izindawo eziningi ngamakhathalogi aphakathi, isitoko ngendawo ngayinye, ukubelwa kwabasebenzi nemibiko ehlanganisiwe.

security.title: Izindima nezimvume
security.body: Nikeza abanikazi, abaphathi nabakhokhisi ukufinyelela abakudingayo kuphela. Izikrini ezibucayi zingakhawulelwa ngokwendima.

pricing.title: Amanani alula futhi asobala
pricing.intro: Khokha nge-akhawunti, ngenyanga. Akukho ukuboshwa kuhadiwe futhi akukho zimali zesithengiselwano ezivela ku-Budify.
pricing.currencyNote: Amanani ambiswa nge-{currency}, ngaphandle kwezintela. Amanani eshaji angumlingiso – amanani okugcina aqinisekiswa kukhotheshini yakho.

growth.name: Growth
bullets: Indlu yokugcina kanye nezitolo ezifika ku-5

faq: Amanani awafaki i-VAT, i-GST noma ezinye izintela ezisebenzayo.
Ihadiwe (amathemineli, amaskena, amaphrinta) ithengwa ngokwehlukile kumhlinzeki oyikhethayo.
Amaphlani angahluka ngemakethe kuye ngamamojuli atholakalayo.

integrations.title: Ukuxhumana nemibiko
integrations.intro: I-Budify ixhumana nehadiwe namathuluzi ezezimali asetshenziswa ngabaphathi, futhi ikhiqiza izincwadi zokuthekelelwa zemibiko elawulwayo. Ukutholakala kuyahluka ngemakethe.

hardware.title: Ihadiwe
hardware.body: Isebenza namathemineli e-POS e-Android, amaskena ebhakhodi namaphrinta ama-risidi. Izinsimbi ezihambisanayo ziyatholakala ngesikhathi sokuqala.

payments.title: Izinkokhelo
payments.body: Rekhoda izinkokhelo zemali, zekhadi nezama-akhawunti. Ukuxhumana nabahlinzeki bezinkokhelo kuncike emakethe yakho futhi kuqinisekiswa ngesikhathi sokuqala.

accounting.title: Ukuthekelelwa kwezabalo
accounting.body: Thekelela ukuthengisa, izindleko nenani lesitoko nge-CSV kumcwaningi wakho wezimali noma kusofthiwekhompyutha yezabalo.

api.title: Ukuthekelelwa kwemininingwane ne-API
api.body: Ukuthekelelwa kwe-CSV okucwaningiwe namuhla; i-API enemibhalo ne-webhooks kusendleleni yethu (roadmap).

integrations.traceIntro: Uhlu olungezansi lubonisa isimo senketho ngayinye yemakethe yakho. “Isendleleni (roadmap)” kusho kuhlelelwe kodwa kungakatholakali. I-Budify ayifayeli imibiko egameni lakho futhi ayiyona isistimu ye-seed-to-sale enelayisense.

solutions.title: Izixazululo ngohlobo lwenhlangano
solutions.intro: Ipulatifomu efanayo, elungiselelwe indlela osebenza ngayo.

clubs.title: Amaklabhu amalungu nezinhlangano
clubs.body: Ezinhlanganweni nasemaklabhini amalungu azimele: phatha amarejista amalungu, isimo sobulungu, izimali namarekhodi ibhodi yakho nezinhlaka ezibusayo ezingawacela.

groups.title: Amaqembu ezindawo eziningi
groups.body: Kubaphathi abanezindawo eziningi: amakhathalogi aphakathi, isitoko ngendawo ngayinye, izindima zabasebenzi nemibiko ehlanganisiwe.

white-label.body: Kumaqembu, ama-federation nabalingani bobuchwepheshe abafuna i-Budify ngaphansi kophawu lwabo, ngendawo ezinikele.

compliance.intro: Indlela i-Budify esekela ngayo ukugcinwa kwamarekhodi nokubika emakethe ngayinye. Lolu ulwazi jikelele ngesofthiwekhompyutha yethu, hhayi iseluleko somthetho.

statement.intro: I-Budify izinikele ekwenzeni le webhusayithi isetshenziswe yiwo wonke umuntu. Sihlose ukuhlangabezana ne-Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 izinga le-AA.

statement.limits: Lesi sitatimende sisalungiswa. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kokuhambisana kusabekwenziwa.
